statements.quote: Section 1.9, Submission Due Date, page 5: replace "09/15/2023 by 4:00PM" with "09/29/2023 by 4:00PM".
Specification Section 1.1.E.1, page 55: replace "eighteen (18) 15kV vacuum circuit breaker positions" with "twenty (20) 15kV vacuum circuit breaker positions".
statements.text: Specification requires twenty (20) 15kV vacuum circuit breaker positions.

statements.quote: Specification Section 1.1.E, page 56: add the following as item 11. "The switchgear lineup shall be seismically qualified for the site, and the MANUFACTURER shall provide the seismic qualification report with the submittals."
statements.text: The switchgear lineup must be seismically qualified for the site, with the seismic qualification report provided with the submittals.

statements.quote: Specification Part 1, after Section 1.6: add the following as Section 1.7, Warranty. "The MANUFACTURER shall warrant the switchgear lineup against defects in materials and workmanship for sixty (60) months from the date of energization."
statements.text: The MANUFACTURER shall warrant the switchgear lineup against defects in materials and workmanship for sixty (60) months from the date of energization.

statements.quote: Specification Section 1.1.D.3, page 55: the sentence "In addition to other Submittal requirements, final drawings shall be submitted as AutoCAD format files." is deleted in its entirety.
statements.text: The requirement to submit final drawings as AutoCAD format files is deleted.

statements.quote: Question: Is arc-resistant Type 2B construction required? Answer: Yes, arc-resistant Type 2B construction is required as specified in Section 1.1.E.2; no change.
statements.text: Arc-resistant Type 2B construction is required as specified in Section 1.1.E.2.

statements.text: Acknowledge receipt of this addendum on the proposal form.
